full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 17.02.2010 passed by the High Court in First Appeal No.117 of 1998 affirming the judgment and decree dated 25.2.1998 passed by the Subordinate Judge Court, Narayanganj in Title Suit No. 345 of 1992 dismissing the suit. 

 15. After hearing the parties, the Subordinate Judge, Additional Court, Narayanganj dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 25.02.1998. 

 16. Against the judgment and decree dated 25.02.1998 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Additional Court, Narayanganj in Title Suit No. 345 of 1992, the plaintiff preferred First Appeal No. 117 of 1998.
